API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPrivileged Credential ManagementGets the privileged credential details for the specified customer.
Gets the privileged credential details for the specified customer.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/credential/:id

Gets the privileged credential details for the specified customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

id
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the privileged credential.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

OK
